candidates_tested.description: how fast the escalated amount was reached (max_amount / days to escalate) - a patient ring and a fast-strike ring look different here even at the same amount
combined device+address sharing count - a stronger single ring signal than either alone
purchase count relative to time - flags accounts that transact unusually rapidly before escalating
1 only if BOTH device and address are shared - isolates coordinated rings from incidental single-signal overlap (e.g. a shared household address only)
time between account creation and the first purchase - a long dormant period before any activity is itself a pattern
